verdict.rationale: Channel3 is agent-commerce infrastructure sitting between shopping agents and merchants, so verifiable agent identity is a fair axis for it. The evidence shows no registered agent profiles, request signatures, or trust tiers exposed to merchants. API keys, keyless MCP access, MPP payments, and user identifiers for click attribution are adjacent access and attribution mechanisms, not verifiable agent identification.

support.subject: As a merchant, agents identify themselves verifiably — registered profiles, signatures, or trust tiers — so I can tell trusted agent traffic from anonymous bots
